title: AI Core Module
summary: The AI Core module provides the foundational components for building and managing AI agents, integrating with various models and external tools, and ensuring robust execution and evaluation.

nodes.label: Agent Framework
nodes.title: Agent Framework
nodes.description: Defines the core abstractions for AI agents, managing their lifecycle, interactions, and tool orchestration.

nodes.label: Capabilities & Tools
nodes.title: Capabilities and Tools
nodes.description: Manages the definition, registration, and execution of various capabilities and tools that agents can use to interact with external systems.

nodes.label: Model Integration
nodes.title: Model Integration
nodes.description: Provides a unified interface for interacting with various AI models, handling requests, streaming responses, and managing model-specific configurations.

nodes.label: Providers & Embeddings
nodes.title: Providers and Embeddings
nodes.description: Offers interfaces for integrating with diverse AI model providers and generating text embeddings, abstracting away provider-specific details.

nodes.label: Utilities
nodes.title: Utilities
nodes.description: Contains general-purpose utilities such as concurrency management, direct model interaction, prompt formatting, and runtime context management.

nodes.label: Durable Execution
nodes.title: Durable Execution
nodes.description: Integrates AI agents with durable execution frameworks like DBOS, Prefect, and Temporal, enabling robust and fault-tolerant workflows.

nodes.label: Evaluation & Testing
nodes.title: Evaluation and Testing
nodes.description: Provides tools for defining, generating, and managing datasets, evaluating model outputs, and performing online evaluations and testing.

nodes.label: Graph & MCP
nodes.title: Graph and MCP
nodes.description: Defines core components for building and executing directed graphs, and functionalities for interacting with Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.

nodes.label: Documentation & UI
nodes.title: Documentation and UI
nodes.description: Manages documentation generation, CLI tools, and user interface integrations for Pydantic AI agents.

groups.label: Core AI Components
groups.title: Core AI Components
groups.description: The fundamental building blocks for defining, running, and interacting with AI agents and models.

groups.label: Supporting Infrastructure
groups.title: Supporting Infrastructure
groups.description: Modules providing essential utilities, graph execution capabilities, and Model Context Protocol integration.

groups.label: Advanced Features & Extensions
groups.title: Advanced Features and Extensions
groups.description: Modules enabling robust, fault-tolerant execution and comprehensive evaluation of AI systems.

groups.label: User-Facing & Dev Tools
groups.title: User-Facing and Developer Tools
groups.description: Components for user interaction, documentation, and developer utilities.
